requirements.desc: post hook failure reflects as exit code 1 in both envelope and raw modes

requirements.desc: envelope mode preserves POST_HOOK_FAILED warning with ok=true

requirements.note: logic only forces exit 1 when postFailed=true; envelope success remains exit 0 and raw without post does not force exit 1, both covered by tests.

requirements.desc: pre hook and command body failure exit behavior unchanged

requirements.desc: raw mode stderr message for post hook failure is preserved
requirements.note: raw-mode catch still writes post hook failure to stderr, and new test verifies stderr contains the error message.

requirements.desc: sync and async post hook throws both result in exit code 1
requirements.note: post hook is awaited in try/catch, so both sync throw and async reject set postFailed=true; tests added for both sync and async failures.
